summary: Defines the MIME types associated with MP4 files and recommends which registered type to use depending on the kind of content. This helps servers and mail programs label audio and video files correctly. It is standards-track and was later updated by RFC 6381.

eli5.summary: Every file needs a label on the outside so computers know if it is music or a movie. This sets the labels for MP4 files.

questions: which media type should mp4 audio use
